description: Validates Tailwind utility classes against the JIT engine by programmatically compiling them. Supports complex arbitrary values, JIT modifiers, and custom plugin classes. Returns the generated CSS rules.

class_string.description: Space-separated Tailwind class string to compile

config_path.description: Optional path to tailwind.config.js/ts (for Tailwind v3 custom configs)

css_path.description: Optional path to the project's CSS entry file (for Tailwind v4 custom theme styles)

name: simulate_jit_compilation
